# Archify (vendored)

Upstream: [tt-a1i/archify](https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify) (MIT).

Used by Tier0 Slide Skill for **validated** architecture / workflow / sequence / dataflow / lifecycle diagrams. Visual output must be themed with `assets/tier0-slide-theme.css` via `scripts/apply-archify-tier0-theme.mjs` — see `references/diagrams-tier0.md`.

Do not ship Archify default cyan/violet console colors into customer decks.
